caption: The drawing contains four square swatches of patterned fabric arranged in a 2x2 grid on a plain, light beige background. The top left swatch features a magenta background with black and white abstract motifs and scattered red dots. The top right swatch displays a beige background with repeating floral patterns composed of black, red, and white elements, accented by small brown dots. The bottom left swatch shows a brown background with small, white, symmetrical branch-like patterns and red and white oval shapes positioned regularly throughout. The bottom right swatch has a striped design with alternating black, red, and white vertical stripes, where some stripes contain small white floral motifs and others are filled with thin black dashes; larger black and white abstract motifs are interspersed across the red stripes.
title: Materials from Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
